data.title: Manual Tester
data.qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Applications, or related field
data.summary: Join our quality assurance practice to perform thorough functional, exploratory, and regression testing across modern web and mobile applications.
data.description: We are seeking a diligent Manual Tester who takes genuine pride in defect discovery and user journey verification. In this role, you will collaborate closely with development teams, craft detailed test scenarios, report actionable issues, and ensure production releases meet our uncompromising quality bar.
data.responsibilities:
• Design, author, and execute comprehensive test plans, test suites, and test cases.
• Conduct functional, regression, sanity, exploratory, and cross-browser testing on web applications.
• Identify, isolate, document, and track bugs through clear defect reports with reproducible steps.
• Collaborate with software developers, product designers, and project managers during sprint cycles.
• Verify bug fixes and participate in release qualification reviews.
data.skills: Manual Testing, Test Case Design, Defect Life Cycle, Jira, Regression Testing, Web Application Testing
data.preferredSkills: Basic SQL, Postman API Testing, Agile Methodologies, Mobile App Testing

data.title: Playwright Automation Tester
data.qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent technical degree
data.summary: Build robust, modern end-to-end test automation suites utilizing Playwright and TypeScript for high-velocity software delivery.
data.description: Codfis is expanding our test automation practice. We are looking for an automation tester with proven experience building Playwright frameworks. You will automate critical user flows, integrate tests into continuous delivery pipelines, and ensure that our applications remain resilient against regressions.
data.responsibilities:
• Architect and maintain modular, reliable end-to-end automation suites using Playwright.
• Develop automated API and UI tests adhering to Page Object Model (POM) and modern fixture designs.
• Integrate automated test execution into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins).
• Analyze test run reports, triage flaky tests, and maintain high test suite stability.
• Mentor junior quality engineers in automation best practices.
data.skills: Playwright, JavaScript / TypeScript, Node.js, Page Object Model, Git, CI/CD Integration
data.preferredSkills: Postman, Docker, Performance Testing, Allure Reporting

data.title: Selenium Automation Tester
data.qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA or equivalent
data.summary: Drive test automation for enterprise web applications using Selenium WebDriver, Java, and modern test frameworks.
data.description: We are looking for a skilled Selenium Automation Tester with strong Java fundamentals. You will design, build, and maintain automated test suites, execute cross-browser validation, and contribute to test automation frameworks that support continuous integration.
data.responsibilities:
• Develop automated test scripts using Selenium WebDriver with Java and TestNG.
• Implement and maintain robust Page Object Model (POM) architectures and data-driven frameworks.
• Perform cross-browser and parallel test execution across Chrome, Firefox, and Edge.
• Execute SQL queries to validate backend database integrity during test runs.
• Coordinate with development teams to ensure complete test coverage for new features.
data.skills: Selenium WebDriver, Java, TestNG, Maven, XPath, SQL, Git
data.preferredSkills: Jenkins CI/CD, Cucumber BDD, REST Assured, ExtentReports

data.title: Java Developer
data.qualification: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related discipline
data.summary: Build high-performance, resilient enterprise backend services and REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot.
data.description: Codfis is seeking a Java Developer with strong object-oriented design skills and hands-on experience building backend microservices. You will participate in architecture discussions, implement clean APIs, optimize database queries, and ensure application reliability.
data.responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain backend microservices and RESTful APIs using Java and Spring Boot.
• Apply clean code principles, SOLID patterns, and domain-driven design.
• Write clean SQL queries, design database schemas, and optimize database access via JPA / Hibernate.
• Author comprehensive unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito.
• Collaborate on system design, code reviews, and performance profiling.
data.skills: Java 17+, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Hibernate/JPA, PostgreSQL or MySQL, JUnit, Git
data.preferredSkills: Docker, Spring Security, Kafka, Microservices Architecture

data.qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / MCA or equivalent degree
data.summary: Architect scalable web services, data models, and backend business logic for custom enterprise applications.

data.title: AI QA Engineer
data.qualification: B.E. / B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science, AI, or related field
data.summary: Evaluate, validate, and build automated verification frameworks for AI models, LLM outputs, and intelligent agent workflows.
